q: I'm not good with computers. Is that a problem?
a: Not at all. We do everything for you: the design, the writing, the web address and the setup. You just tell us about your business.
You'll see a free preview of your website within a few days. Once you're happy, we can usually have it live the same week.

q: Is the free preview really free?
a: Yes. We build a preview of your website at no cost and with no obligation. If you don't like it, you don't pay anything.

q: Will callers know they are talking to an AI?
a: Yes. Our receptionist always says it is an AI assistant. It's friendly and helpful, takes messages, and can pass urgent calls to you.

q: I already have a website. Can you help?
a: Yes. If your website is old, slow or hard to use on a phone, we can replace it with a new one and move your web address over.
